contract_freeze.contract_policy: Contract V2.1 is copied and hashed; schema, prompts, acceptance gate, review labels, and RQ1 denominators are not changed.

selection_rule.fault_pool: All 580 frozen Contract V2.1 accepted contracts are offered to deterministic broad mutation; no gold-PASS filter, detectable-only filter, or replay-result selection is permitted. A contract for which no deterministic mutation is emitted remains as FAULT_NOT_EMITTED in the pre-replay fault-construction coverage.
selection_rule.controls: Every frozen contract receives an independently constructed synthetic negative control before execution. Legacy reference controls are retained only as a raw diagnostic.

metric_definitions.executor_compatibility: A replay side is compatible only when its status is PASS or VIOLATION; INVALID_WITNESS, UNSUPPORTED, ERROR, and missing outcomes remain in the full denominator.
metric_definitions.trigger_rate: Fault VIOLATION rate, reported both over all emitted faults and among fault-executor-compatible rows.
metric_definitions.raw_control_trigger_rate: Observed control VIOLATION rate over all controls; this is not a false-trigger estimate because reference controls may be intrinsically contract-positive.
metric_definitions.certified_false_trigger_rate: Independent synthetic-control VIOLATIONs divided by all 580 controls certified negative from their matched construction without inspecting executor outcomes.
metric_definitions.witness_valid_rate: Independently code-audited valid witnesses divided by all triggered faults; reconstruction failures count as invalid.

reporting_guardrails: This is executor/validation evidence under controlled faults, not a new Contract V2.2 construction-quality claim.
No V2.1 contract, reviewer label, RQ1 denominator, or paper-facing table is overwritten.
Fault-construction losses are reported against all 580 frozen contracts; executor, trigger, control, and witness rates use the emitted-pair denominator stated in each row.
Reference-SQL controls are retained only as a raw diagnostic. Specificity uses a separate full-census synthetic control pool certified safe by matched construction before execution.
All compatibility losses, untriggered faults, control alerts, and witness failures remain visible in their declared denominators.
